text:
Olivia K.: Quick sync — Orpheus Labs asked to go live on marketplace + a short joint announcement when their preview silicon hits our dedicated nodes. Need: NDA signed, baseline benchmark run (latency + 99p), and marketing draft. Who can own which piece?
Sam T.: I can run the benchmarks. Do we have their power/thermal telemetry export? that affects perf curves. :thinking_face:
Raj P.: We need the harness they promised (docker image + `run_bench.sh`). last time we had to patch the --kvcache flag. also need target seq len and concurrency knob.
Emma L.: Legal has a small redline on the data-sharing clause — I'm sending a single-source NDA redline to Orpheus now. should be quick but expect one round.
Olivia K.: thanks. Sam — once you get the harness, can you run `./run_bench.sh --model redwood-small --iters 100 --seq 1024` and post raw logs to s3://redwood-partner-logs/orpheus/preview1/ ?
Sam T.: yep. pinging Orpheus for the image and an s3 token. aiming to run tomorrow morning. will post TL;DR + raw logs. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: perf-ci: baseline harness sanity checks passed on our infra (no segfaults). link: https://ci.internal/redwood/bench/2524681357
Raj P.: FYI, add a note to the run to capture `NVML` power snapshots every 5s. we want to estimate watts/token for the marketplace listing.
Sam T.: will add NVML sampling. example snippet for power capture i used before: `while true; do nvidia-smi --query-gpu=power.draw --format=csv -l 5 >> power.csv; done &`
Emma L.: when Orpheus returns the NDA, I'll review. marketing asked for a 2-paragraph co-announcement by EOD Friday — Olivia, can you draft a short ops blurb we can share with product marketing?
Olivia K.: I'll draft the ops blurb and include a short compatibility note about pinned model versions + fallback policy. will share in this thread by Thu AM.
Sam T.: if the benchmark passes, we should include a latency graph and a short note on batching config (we used dynamic batching with max_batch=8).
Raj P.: also capture the `--quant-mode` setting in the run metadata. some partners assume int8 defaults.
Olivia K.: action items captured: Emma -> NDA redline to Orpheus; Sam -> run bench + NVML logs + upload; Raj -> bench knobs checklist; Olivia -> ops blurb + announce draft. We'll reconvene after logs posted. Thanks all. :rocket:
